title: Citrix security advisory (AV26-1150)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1150 Date: November 12, 2026 As of November 12, 2026, Citrix is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway Prior to 13.1-64.39 Prior to 14.1-73.57 NetScaler ADC FIPS Prior to 14.1-73.58 FIPS Prior to 13.1-37.293 FIPS & NDcPP NetScaler Console Prior to 14.1-74.34 Secure Access Client for Linux Prior to 26.10.4 Secure Access Client for Windows Prior to 26.11.16 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. Security updates for NetScaler ADC, NetScaler Gateway, and NetScaler Console Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway Security Bulletin Citrix NetScaler Console Security Bulletin for CVE-2026-120869 Citrix Secure Access Client for Linux Security Bulletin for CVE-2026-118269 Citrix Secure Access Client for Windows Security Bulletin for CVE-2026-118268 Citrix Security Advisories Article Link: Citrix security advisory (AV26-1150) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
